notes: v1.14.571 — BOOT LANDS ON THE RACK PICKER, NOT THE STATUS MUSEUM. IA-SHIFTNAV v2 Ship 2 (P-5). One visible change: with a Master loaded and a live active deployment, launch now opens on the deployment's rack picker instead of Command. ⭐ SCOPE CORRECTED BY MEASUREMENT BEFORE ANY EDIT — THE THIRD TIME IN THIS CAMPAIGN, AFTER .559 AND .564. P-5 wrote Ship 2 as "a new surface, medium risk — must scope its search to the active deployment", and budgeted a picker build. The picker ALREADY EXISTS WHOLE inside deploy_showDetail: the RACK LIST / FLOOR MAP toggle, the rackLookup_* state machine (search, filter chips, per-deployment recents, prefix-then-substring ranking, result cap, empty states) and the floor map with blocked flags and phase pips, every tile already one tap to deploy_showRackDetail. Building a second one would have been churn, so the ship narrowed to the landing and the narrowing is reported rather than performed quietly. ⭐ THE §0 HARD RULE WAS ALREADY SATISFIED BY CONSTRUCTION, NOT BY LUCK: rackLookup_init(deployId) sources deploy_computeDeployRollup(deployId) and the results filter THAT scoped array, so no cross-deployment pick is reachable and NO B14 DISAMBIGUATION IS OWED. It also resets on deployment switch, so the cache-outlives-its-owner trap is already handled. NOTHING WAS BUILT — the app starts where the picker already lived. ⛔ ORDERING IS THE SAFETY: the new block runs LAST in redesign_initToggle and only appends, so everything above executes exactly as it did at .570 and EVERY failure path leaves the tech on Command — which is also the ruled zero-state for no Master / no active deployment. ⛔ THREE GUARDS, ALL LOAD-BEARING: a stale id would make deploy_showDetail toast "Deployment not found" at launch, a CLOSED deployment would route to the read-only tombstone, and — the one that matters most — ACTIVE_DEPLOYMENT_KEY and ACTIVE_CTX_KEY ARE TWO STORES FOR ONE TRUTH. activeContext_setDeployment nulls ctx.rackId and ctx.phaseId when they disagree; today that costs a rack pointer only on a deliberate tap, but an automatic landing would fire that write UNATTENDED ON EVERY LAUNCH. The landing DECLINES on genuine disagreement rather than reaching into the data path to change it — a layout ship does not touch a data path. An empty ctx is not a disagreement; that is first run. ⚠ Back is unchanged: deploy_showDetail pushes its own nav state and the seeded root returns to the redesign frame, the same Back the Build → detail path has always had. ⚠ NOT MEASURED ON DEVICE AND NOT RE-MEASURED FOR TAP COUNTS — P-3 requires a before/after count from the ship that lands this, and it is owed.
